  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check`, the `expired_marker_post_failed` branch has two retry problems. The close PATCH succeeds, the expired-marker comment POST fails and the reopen PATCH succeeds, so no durable marker is written. Every poll tick then repeats the close/reopen flap and also sends the new `tg_notify_issue ... "WARNING" || true` Telegram alert, which has no dedupe.
  WHY: While comment POSTs keep failing (for example from secondary rate limits or a locked issue), the 15-minute poll schedule can send up to about 96 Telegram WARNINGs a day for one stuck issue, where before the last run this path only logged a `::warning::` line. All four reviewers rated it NIT, so there is no severity disagreement; it is mapped to low because NIT is not an allowed severity value.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21287-21293 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In `_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check`, after the reopen PATCH succeeds, the last autofix run added an unconditional `tg_notify_issue "${issue_num}" "Heal counterfactual hold: the hold-expired comment failed to post, so the issue was reopened and the expiry retries next tick. ..." "WARNING" || true`. Nothing durable is written, so each tick repeats the close, the failed POST, the reopen and the WARNING.
  WHY: The function's only dedupe is its comment markers, and this path writes none. If comment POSTs keep failing while the PATCH works, the issue flips closed and open every tick and sends a Telegram WARNING each time, which can be dozens a day; before this run the branch only logged `::warning::`. Suggested fix: send it on first failure only, or drop it to DEBUG (1-3 lines).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21278-21280 (hardening suggestion; escalation and expired note bodies) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The jq answer filter treats a maintainer `/answer` as an answer that restarts the clock, but neither the escalation notice nor the expired notice mentions `/answer`.
  WHY: The behaviour is correct, but maintainers are not told about the third option. Suggested fix: add "/answer" to the escalation note, or add a one-line comment saying it is left out on purpose (1-2 lines).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21292 (hardening suggestion; duplicates the finding above)
  PROBLEM: The per-tick Telegram WARNING has no dedupe.
  WHY: Suggested fix: lower it to "DEBUG" or guard it with a tick-local associative array keyed by issue number, and keep `::warning::` as the operator signal (1-3 lines).
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer confirmed the switch defaults at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3018-3026, the forwarding in all five orchestrate_poll.yml env blocks, the escalation and expiry handling, the implementation-first resolver with its #9212-shape test, the ci.yml wiring, the README rows, and the agents.d and changelog fragments. The ai:merge-base-sync loop and the stable-release dispatches are out of scope.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines ~21290-21295 (the new `tg_notify_issue ... "WARNING" || true` before `reason="expired_marker_post_failed"; break` in `_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check`) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the close PATCH succeeds, the expired-comment POST fails and the reopen PATCH succeeds, the branch sends the new Telegram WARNING. No expired marker is recorded, so every later poll tick re-enters the same branch.
  WHY: The schedule in .github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-poll.yml runs every 15 minutes, so sustained comment-POST failures produce up to ~96 WARNING messages a day for one stuck issue; before, this path logged only a `::warning::` line per tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~21294 (hardening suggestion; duplicates the finding above) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The Telegram WARNING is sent unconditionally on every tick and has no deduplication key.
  WHY: Suggested fix: read the latest trusted `<!-- ai:heal-counterfactual-hold-expired:v1 ... -->` marker and suppress both the close PATCH and the Telegram alert if it is present. Otherwise send the alert only when no `<!-- ai:heal-counterfactual-hold-expired-retry-notice:v1 ... -->` comment exists within `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_HOLD_MAX_DAYS`, using one cached comments read. This bounds Telegram to one message per issue per `max_days` (6-10 lines).
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer reports all Phase 7 deliverables present: counterfactual hold expiry, the implementation-first stall judge, three env vars with defaults, CI wiring, the agents.d and changelog.d fragments, and the README rows.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21287-21293, especially the Telegram send at 21292 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When posting the expired marker fails but reopening succeeds, this path sends a Telegram WARNING on every retry.
  WHY: The failed post leaves no expired marker to stop retries, the poll runs every 15 minutes, and `tg_notify_issue` sends without deduplication, so a sustained failure can produce up to 96 Telegram warnings a day.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21292 (hardening suggestion; duplicates the finding above) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The retry path repeats the same Telegram warning on every 15-minute poll while the expired-marker post keeps failing.
  WHY: Suggested fix: keep the per-run workflow warning and stop sending the repeated Telegram warning from this path (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21287-21293 (`_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check`, `expired_marker_post_failed` branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The retry path is not idempotent-latched: no `ai:heal-counterfactual-hold-expired:v1` marker is recorded when the comment POST fails. Every 15-minute tick re-runs the close PATCH and the reopen PATCH, echoes `::warning::` and sends a Telegram WARNING, which can mean up to 96 flaps and 96 warnings a day.
  WHY: The jq scan latches state only through the hold, escalation and expired markers, and this path writes none, so the tick work repeats indefinitely. A previous editor pass accepted the flap as intended, so the reviewer reports this as a residual NIT; the new Telegram send is what the last run introduced.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 21292 (hardening suggestion; duplicates the finding above) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The Telegram WARNING fires on every retry tick with no dedupe, unlike the escalation path, which is latched by its marker.
  WHY: Suggested fix: keep `::warning::` on every tick and either gate the Telegram send or remove it. The smallest form is to delete the `tg_notify_issue` call at line 21292 and fold its guidance into the line 21291 `::warning::` text (1-2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
